notes: Caller for the %parlel macro. Keeps the macro's PROC MEANS statement verbatim (noprint nway; var revenue expenses; class facility productline; output out=&tbl.1 sum(revenue)=sumRevenue sum(expenses)=sumExpenses;) and its %do 1..15 loop of consecutive passes. Upstream %parlel(drv,tbl) libnames a physical drive and runs against a 20,000,000-record table; here a small WORK table is built the same way the upstream generator does (do facility / do productline / cats()) so no external drive is needed. The 15-pass output dataset m160_11 is printed to show the eight-group facility x productline summary, matching the structure of the results table in the upstream README.
